name: test_prerequisite_issues_name_real_settings
description:
Objective: Every blocked-prerequisite issue names real settings that lift it.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Check each issue's requires names exist in config.settings.
Expected: 1. No undefined setting names; every blocked_prerequisite issue lists its settings.
